item.title: Montclair is Cheering on One of Their Own in Pierri at Winter Olympics
item.description: Jacquie Pierri, a Montclair High School graduate from 2008, is skating for the Italian national team during the Olympics and a group of about a dozen were watching her skate on a Thursday morning at Just Jake's in Montclair. It is the first time in 20 years that Italy has a representative in the Winter Olympics in the sport.
